title: Planter
description: An exercise created to test my ability to combine what I've learned through photography, design, and sculpture. Using color, I attempted to move the audience's eye around the page in the path of an X, keeping the viewer engaged through chaos.

brief.label: Brief
brief.text: An exercise combining photography, design and sculpture.

brief.label: Composition
brief.text: Color moves the eye around the frame along the path of an X.

study_intro: A composition study as much as an object: photography, design and sculpture in one frame.

study.label: Form
study.text: Soft, pebble- and fruit-like vessels with a cut opening, so each pot looks picked rather than manufactured.

study.label: Color
study.text: Red, white and a bold blue drape: color is used to move the eye around the frame along an X.

study.label: Setting
study.text: A dark, reflective, cave-like set that makes the forms glow.
